name: Animals (example)
question: Which group best matches this description?

children.name: Cat
children.description: retractable claws, whiskers, purrs, hunts small prey

children.name: Dog
children.description: barks, wags tail, domesticated pack animal, keen sense of smell

children.name: Mouse
children.description: tiny rodent, long thin tail, gnaws, squeaks

children.name: Giraffe
children.description: extremely long neck, spotted coat, eats tree leaves

children.name: Reptiles
children.description: cold-blooded, dry scaly skin, lay eggs

children.name: Snake
children.description: legless, long flexible body, flicking tongue

children.name: Lizard
children.description: four legs, scales, long tail, basks on rocks

children.name: Turtle
children.description: hard shell, slow moving, retracts its head

children.name: Ant
children.description: tiny social insect, colony, carries food in lines

children.name: Butterfly
children.description: large colorful wings, feeds on nectar, starts as a caterpillar

children.name: Beetle
children.description: hard wing covers, chewing mouthparts, many species

examples.title: Cat
examples.text: A small furry pet with whiskers and retractable claws that purrs when petted and chases mice.

examples.title: Turtle
examples.text: A slow animal with a hard domed shell that pulls its head inside when scared, and lays eggs on the beach.

examples.title: Butterfly
examples.text: A flying creature with large colorful wings that drinks nectar from flowers after emerging from a chrysalis.
